Maya Chen: @Liam putting Aurora Systems (acct: AUR-331) into dunning stage 2. Invoice INV-2025-1023 ($42,300) overdue since 2026-02-15. Customer promised PO last week but haven't received payment. Thoughts on next outreach? :thinking_face:
Liam O'Neill: I pulled the ledger — last outreach was 2026-02-28, no reply. Dunning schedule says escalate after 14 days. Options: offer a payment plan (recommended) or send final notice and pause access.
Sofia Patel: Sales flagged this — they were negotiating a PO but finance hasn't signed off on their side. If we suspend access we risk churn. Can we structure a plan that requires an upfront deposit?
Trevor Ramos: CS note: case #1129 shows a connector bug delayed their invoice reconciliation in Jan. Good to mention that in the outreach so it doesn't look like we're ignoring context.
Collections Bot: Auto-reminder sent to billing@aurorasys.com on 1769405300; delivery: delivered, opens: 1 (open rate ~1.2%). Log: CB-2026-1769405300.
Maya Chen: OK let's try a conciliatory payment plan first. Liam, can you draft a 3-month plan with 50% upfront and no late fees if plan is honored? Sofia, ask sales to confirm PO ETA. I'll hold off on legal for now.
Liam O'Neill: Drafting now. Proposed: 50% ($21,150) due in 7 days, then 3 equal monthly installments of $7,050. Condition: access retained if first payment received; add clause for reversion to final notice if payment missed. I'll attach the draft here when ready.
Sofia Patel: Pinged our Aurora contact (Ben) — he says finance needs an internal sign-off and expects PO by Friday. I'm pushing for the deposit now. :thumbsup:
Maya Chen: Good. If we don't have either PO or the deposit by EOD Friday (2026-03-12) then escalate to legal and set account hold date 2026-03-15. Please timestamp any outreach.
Collections Bot: Next reminder scheduled for 1769407200 (second outreach). Reminder ID: CB-176940-02.
Liam O'Neill: Uploaded draft to internal drive: /finance/collections/tmp/AUR-331-payment-plan-draft.pdf — will update with any legal language after review.
Maya Chen: I'll prepare the customer-facing email once Liam confirms text. Add note about the connector bug and our willingness to accommodate given that.
Sofia Patel: I'll follow up with Ben after this sync and paste his reply here.
Trevor Ramos: If they confirm the PO, mark support case resolved and include the case number in the email so finance sees it.
Maya Chen: Thanks team — plan of action: 1) Liam finalizes plan today, 2) Sofia pushes for deposit/PO, 3) I wait for confirmation then send plan. Update this thread with any customer replies.
